current_context: main is at d5ff25b9 (PR #326 merged), v12.0.0, npm latest and stable both 12.0.0. CI was green on every PR merged this cycle. tests/ has 145 files: clean full runs by the pre-commit hook were 142 passed / 0 failed / 3 skipped on #325 and 141/0/3/144 on #326 (which predated #325). The combined main was run once at machine load about 20 and showed 140 passed, 2 failed, 3 skipped: harness-audit and install-module-load hit the runner's 60 second per-test limit, and both pass alone (25/25 and 16/16); there is no clean full run of the exact combined tree yet, expect 142 passed. The suite is load-sensitive: above load ~10 installer and harness tests time out and the Husky pre-commit hook rejects a sound commit, so wait for uptime below ~5 instead of bypassing the hook. This cycle's work: #321 added a generated plugins/mindforge/README.md (from scripts/plugin-readme.template.md via scripts/build-mindforge-plugin.js) that the Anthropic plugin directory requires, after a 42-finding multi-agent review showed the first draft overclaimed; #322 cleared the required Security Scan check (new advisories in mcp-server dependencies fast-uri, hono, ip-address) and rebuilt the bundled MCP server; #325 stopped tracking 73 colon-named files under .agent/workflows that Windows cannot check out; #326 fixed the hook dispatcher failing closed on every call when the plugin root is reached through a symlink and closed an in-root-symlink escape, after a 15-finding review that found a race in the first version. The 2026-09-24 Console submission was Rejected (its path field was a dot instead of plugins/mindforge) and the Console form is retired. main requires six status checks through rulesets; an admin break-glass bypass exists and was not used.

decisions_needed: Plugin resubmission needs a paid claude.ai plan (Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise; free accounts cannot submit). The owner said they cannot take Pro. Options: apply to the Claude for Open Source program (MindForge is below every stated threshold, so only its apply-anyway clause fits), have a collaborator with a paid plan and push access submit, or skip the directory — the repo's own marketplace already works. Which to pursue is the owner's call.

What to say about /mindforge:auto in any public directory description: the plugin README deliberately does not mention it, because the engine behind it (AutoRunner) is not wired up and the word stuck-detection may overstate it. Not answered.
Whether to re-sync .claude/worktrees/release-v12.0.1 (now 56 commits behind main and 2 ahead, up from 19 behind) or abandon it for a fresh release cut when v12.0.1 is actually ready to ship.

Whether the develop → release → main three-branch flow is still intended policy: every PR this cycle merged directly to main, and develop is now 89 commits behind and 10 ahead (it was 52 behind). Not confirmed as a deliberate change.
Whether to remove the orphaned .agent/workflows folder (57 dash-named files; nothing reads it and the npm package does not ship it). #325 only untracked the 73 colon-named files.

Follow-ups found by the #321 and #326 reviews and not fixed: mindforge-config-protection matches protected names by basename without resolving symlinks, so a symlink alias to tsconfig.json is not protected; a project whose .claude directory is a symlink to a differently named directory derives the wrong hook root and fails closed; hooks.json timeouts are in milliseconds but Claude Code reads seconds; mindforge-context-monitor and the update check are inert in a plugin-only install and instinct-capture may not fire on real payloads; about 16 skills are written for the Hermes runtime and five GitHub skills scrape ~/.git-credentials and .env; validatePath in .agent/bin/lib/security.cjs mixes canonical and lexical paths (latent).

Carried over from 2026-08-21, status NOT re-verified (do not trust these as current without re-checking): D5 plugin asset contract, D6 whether the SDK is published with provenance, D7 what exit code `verify` should use when every stage skips, D8 whether .planning/VERIFICATION.md should be tracked, D9 whether to governance-gate the release path, and whether a --global install should carry bin/ at all.
